mutations.name: fr2-cause-env-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Remove the environment cause; the isolated env fixture must reject resolving codex instead of agy.

mutations.name: fr2-cause-status-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Remove the status cause; each isolated unavailable/exhausted fixture must reject resolving codex.

mutations.name: fr2-cause-cli-absent-dropped
mutations._mechanism: Remove the CLI-absence cause; the isolated cli-absent fixture must reject resolving an absent codex.

mutations._mechanism: Remove the other-peer step; the availability matrix must reject falling back while the other peer is available.
